“The thing that President Trump has invigorated is the Family.”

Video

I remember being so excited at age 12 in 2018 as I eagerly waited every week to watch a new episode of “Roseanne.”

I LOVE the show & @therealRoseanne.

The ratings-HIT show was stolen from us thanks to ABC.

If ABC isn’t going to end Jimmy Kimmel’s show, bring Roseanne BACK!

Over 3 years ago in 2023, President Trump, in an interview with my beautiful mom @realDrGina, was fighting for:

- Voter ID
- Paper ballots
- Same day voting
- No mail-in besides the ill and military.

Trump has been consistent on this.

Pass the SAVE America Act, Congress!

"I think ABC is putting themselves in great jeopardy, actually... This is very serious what's going on there."

Follow: @BoLoudon

Video

I’m sick and tired of deep state agencies undermining President Trump. 

President Trump called for the elimination of swipe fees! Why are a bunch of unelected bureaucrats standing in his way?
